architecture: MONAI 1.6.1 SegResNetDS (init_filters 32, blocks_down 1-2-2-4, instance norm, dsdepth 3; Backend/neuroscan/inference/networks.py)
source: weights/segresnet/segresnet_seed42.pth (best validation epoch of the hybrid-ensemble run), copied unchanged
input: FLAIR, T1, T1CE, T2 at native resolution (1 mm in BraTS); cropped to the brain box; each sequence z-scored over its non-zero voxels
inference: Gaussian sliding window, 128^3 windows, overlap 0.5, no test-time augmentation
output: WT, TC, ET logits; sigmoid above 0.5; ET below et_min_voxels removed; ET inside TC inside WT
